title: RF-129 routing follow-ups from the #725 final review
acceptance: Refreshing on /classes/<id>/live fetches the run payload once, not twice (loadDetail, then getRunPayload).
Back/Forward to the class that is already selected switches the destination without refetching the class or reloading its detail.
A failed Apple sign-in that returns to /sign-in?error=... shows a plain-words error on the sign-in form.
Dashboard tests no longer rely on a setTimeout(0) wait for a queued jsdom history.back() between tests (stub it, or make the reset deterministic).
Decide whether stepTo's 'a return goes Back' design (pendingBack/selfPop) is worth its complexity, or replace it with plain pushes plus a Live-specific rule.
The legacy /?auth= redirect runs outside a useState initializer.
nextAction: Non-blocking findings logged from the final review of #725 (24ceeaf). Pick up after the owner's iPhone check of RF-129. Surface: web.
